title: Mutation testing of control-plane tests
summary: mutmut (PA-mutmut) refuses native Windows ('please use the WSL', upstream issue #397), so a small stdlib AST mutator was subsumed (src/agent_os/orchestrator/mutation.py; comparison/boolean/constant/return/if operators; mutants run in throwaway worktrees). control_plane.py vs tests.test_orchestrator_control_plane: 30/36 killed (0.833) at e6aaa360. Survivors revealed a real defect -- applies_to() returned False on OSError, disabling the guard when the target path cannot be resolved (fail-open) -- plus an untested missing/corrupt-policy fallback, an unasserted failure detail and the directory-itself case. After the fix and four tests: 36/36 (1.0) at 10425545. Baselines for other runtime modules: provider_health.py 0.759 (mostly unpinned boundary constants), test_selection.py 0.741.
